what: Tier-4 success still sets REVISE_PATCH_PATH to ${winner}-output.txt
scenario_or_breakage: Tier 4 writes launcher output to ${winner}-fallback-output.txt but finalize() always builds patch_path from ${winner}-output.txt. A successful ok-fallback run emits a path that does not exist; forensics and the sibling contract break on the primary fix path.
suggested_fix: In finalize() step 5, set patch_path to $REVISE_DIR/${winner}-fallback-output.txt when winner_is_fallback is true, otherwise keep ${winner}-output.txt; document both patterns in revise-plan-with-waterfall.md Outputs.
